feature_contract.goal: Keep exact original Calc3D2D ordinal-rank and rival-car markers attached to each producer vehicle across both stereo eyes in the default R84 game DLL; restore complete pixel shader and native XYZRHW stream paths with per-car child sprite offsets.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only queue-owned original car/rival rank markers with valid per-vehicle view-space Calc3D2D anchor; do not change NaviPub screen HUD/DispRank text, generic alpha HUD, stage +TIME, GOAL, SkyGlow, world geometry, original FFB/input or R26_SAFE rollback.
trace_stages: Original 0xBAEE2 ordinal Calc3D2D wrapper and 0xBB6F5 rival CALL preserve a per-car view-space point, then TagAppendedNodes attaches exact projected semantic to each SpriteNode.
Original D3D9 SpriteNode/queue dispatch selects the producer, but default R84 previously lacked R26_SAFE ProjectedWorldMarker2D in the R30 XYZRHW and R32/R33 shader dispatch pathways.

The new R84 R30 exact projector derives per-eye anchor deltas from original game projection, latched head inverse and relative-eye transforms; R33 physically submits eye-specific VS constants and R30 native XYZRHW UP/VB/IB rerenders per-eye XY, leaving sprite attributes and protected fallback intact.
subcomponents: Restore exact car/rival projected rank semantic routing through independent R30→R32→R33 shader/c64 screen-pass, including per-eye source matrix and per-sprite anchor.
Restore original view-space car anchor and child sprite offsets across R84 XYZRHW primitive and indexed UP/VB/IB paths, without promoting ordinary screen HUD or non-vehicle world particles.
Preserve source XY original glyph spacing, UV/alpha/Z/RHW, fail-closed missing marker/projection/pose/shader/viewport, and verify stereo/unknown-source negative behavior.

TagAppendedNodes publishes original producer and ProjectedMarkerInfo through queue and replay to actual drawing scope.
R84 R30/R32/R33 shader draw and R30 native XYZRHW UP/VB/IB previously classed projected marker as generic HUD/world; R26_SAFE R57 reference matches exact car-specific eye transform.
diagnosis.root_cause: R84 TU split had never carried the exact projected per-vehicle semantic, anchor reprojection and XYZRHW counterpart into the mainline path despite intact original game producer tagging. Normal FOV-only HUD placement loses changing vehicle-relative anchor depth and can detach rank markers.

Do not alter NaviPub/DispRank known-good source or put rank digits on fixed head-locked HUD; preserve original per-marker view-space evidence and reject missing/behind-camera anchors.
